_note: Tier 2 batch w10, 14-20 November 2025. The 18 and 19 November uploads carry the same Jesus-in-Europe sequence; both are extracted so the repetition is countable.

mentions.claim_text: He matches a picture on screen to what he saw, saying you could not see their eyes but could see the lower part.
mentions.quote: That's exactly the way it looked
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image matched to a picture on air.

mentions.claim_text: Jesus seen moving through Europe and through the villages, knocking on doors.
mentions.quote: I SEE JESUS MOVING THROUGHOUT EUROPE
mentions.falsify_match: A reported religious revival across European villages.

mentions.claim_text: The time is late, said three times, as he goes through South America and on to Australia.
mentions.quote: THE TIME IS LATE
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date.

mentions.claim_text: The houses have hinges broken off doors and windows and shingles missing from the roofs, and he knocks anyway.
mentions.quote: hinges are all broken off of their of off their doors
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image of dereliction.

mentions.claim_text: The people in Europe are wearing short overalls with a nice shirt.
mentions.quote: He's going through Europe and they're wearing the shorts
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a description of dress in a vision.

mentions.claim_text: The clothing is identified on air as lederhosen, with a man of large build seen.
mentions.quote: Later hosen is what it's called
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a detail identified live from the description.

mentions.claim_text: Flowers bowing down and turning toward him as he walks the path in Europe.
mentions.quote: there's flowers that are bowing down before him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: Woe pronounced over Miami, then it shoots out to California and Los Angeles like lightning.
mentions.quote: Whoa, whoa, to you, Miami
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment event in Miami and then in California.

mentions.claim_text: A day of sternness and shaking in which everything changes within 24 hours, with a storm coming in New York.
mentions.quote: Within 24 hours, everything will change
mentions.falsify_match: A single day on which American life changes comprehensively.

mentions.claim_text: A lightning bolt and a storm inside Manhattan, running from New York all the way down to Miami.
mentions.quote: there's a lightning bolt and a storm inside of Manhattan
mentions.falsify_match: A shock centred on Manhattan spreading down the coast.

mentions.claim_text: Plymouth Rock, with the settlers praying, taking communion and dedicating America as one nation that fears God.
mentions.quote: they dedicated the land of America as one nation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a historical scene shown in vision.

mentions.claim_text: Strength given supernaturally to finish the battle, knowing that they would be standing here praying today.
mentions.quote: God supernaturally gave him a strength
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a claim about the past and about himself.

mentions.claim_text: Those founding prayers still stand before the Father, and America will not be a goat nation.
mentions.quote: You will not be a goat nation
mentions.falsify_match: America positioned among the nations he calls sheep.

mentions.claim_text: The timeframe played before him a thousand years at a time, like a movie screen.
mentions.quote: he went from from each thousand years
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a survey of history shown in vision.

mentions.claim_text: All of humanity has come to the wire, with artificial babies and manipulation named as the sign.
mentions.quote: with artificial uh babies, manipulation
mentions.falsify_match: Gestation outside the womb becoming an established practice.

mentions.claim_text: The Chinese empire shown with the Great Wall being constructed.
mentions.quote: the Great Wall of China and it was all being in constructed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a historical scene shown in vision.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the president is protected, lives long, finishes strong and that no deadly thing harms him.
mentions.quote: he'll eat any deadly thing and it will not harm him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: he survives, credited to the prayer.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer over Mexico that a godly leader be put in, that Mexico have a move of God, and over the cartels.
mentions.quote: that Mexico will have a move of God
mentions.falsify_match: A change of Mexican government alongside a religious movement.

mentions.claim_text: An aside about a tissue on his face after crying, before turning to Venezuela.
mentions.quote: You had tissue on your face
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an aside.

mentions.claim_text: They will sing Imagine in New York, which he says he warned about.
mentions.quote: the same with what they will sing in New York
mentions.falsify_match: That song used at a New York public occasion in the sense he means.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that God's hand is on Israel concerning politics and war and that his will be done.
mentions.quote: that your great hand is on Israel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer for protection.

mentions.claim_text: Jesus moving throughout Europe and the villages, knocking, in the repeat of the same sequence.
mentions.quote: AND HE'S KNOCKING
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival across European villages.

mentions.claim_text: The time is late, then through South America and on to Australia, repeated.
mentions.quote: AND NOW HE'S GOING ALL THROUGHOUT SOUTH AMERICA
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date.

mentions.claim_text: The broken hinges and missing shingles again, with him knocking at the door.
mentions.quote: They're missing some shingles on their roof
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image of dereliction.

mentions.claim_text: The people in Europe wearing short overalls with a nice shirt, repeated.
mentions.quote: they're wearing the shorts with a little nice shirt
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a description of dress.

mentions.claim_text: Lederhosen identified on air again, with the man of large build.
mentions.quote: People are saying later hosen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a detail identified live.

mentions.claim_text: The flowers turning toward him on the path in Europe, repeated.
mentions.quote: The flowers are turning toward him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: Woe over Miami again, then California and Los Angeles like lightning.
mentions.quote: Whoa, whoa, to you Miami
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment event in Miami and then in California.

mentions.claim_text: A day of sternness and shaking, everything changing within 24 hours, with a storm in New York.
mentions.quote: Within 24 hours, everything will change
mentions.falsify_match: A single day on which everything changes.

mentions.claim_text: A lightning bolt and storm inside Manhattan, running from New York down to Miami, repeated.
mentions.quote: a lightning bolt and a storm inside of Manhattan
mentions.falsify_match: A shock centred on Manhattan spreading down the coast.

mentions.claim_text: Children whose eyes showed a disconnect, in the material he introduces as build-a-baby coming.
mentions.quote: this is what these children looked like in their eyes
mentions.falsify_match: Selected or engineered children becoming a recognised practice.

mentions.claim_text: He says he could spend a year on one prayer project concerning government money, and that is not his focus.
mentions.quote: I could spend a year on one prayer project
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement about how he allocates prayer.

mentions.claim_text: Housekeeping about the length of a clip and whether there are viewer questions.
mentions.quote: 26 minutes. Way too long
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: housekeeping.

mentions.claim_text: Canada will set up laws to suppress freedom of speech further, with prayer for the prime minister.
mentions.quote: they'll set laws up and put things in motion
mentions.falsify_match: New Canadian speech legislation.

mentions.claim_text: They do not poke him as they will the Venezuelan leader because he lacks the capability, and a cold war becomes even colder.
mentions.quote: as I saw a cold war that becomes even colder
mentions.falsify_match: A further deterioration in relations short of open war.

mentions.claim_text: Men with guns running from one point to another with things falling around them, which they interceded over.
mentions.quote: they were running as fast as they could
mentions.falsify_match: A ground engagement matching the scene.

mentions.claim_text: They are revolting against their government in Mexico, protesting and rioting.
mentions.quote: they're protesting and rioting and acting crazy down there
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained anti-government unrest in Mexico.

mentions.claim_text: The military sent in to overthrow the Venezuelan government, with revival breaking out and many born again where there was witchcraft.
mentions.quote: the military to overthrow the Venezuelan government
mentions.falsify_match: Foreign military action removing the government, followed by a revival.

mentions.claim_text: A supernatural harvest for the kingdom in that area, which he says they must believe for.
mentions.quote: see a supernatural harvest for the kingdom of God
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival in the region.

mentions.claim_text: There will be a major move of God in America, repeated for emphasis.
mentions.quote: we're going to have a major move of God in America
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised national revival.

mentions.claim_text: Calling revival in the churches represented and protection over the president.
mentions.quote: We call revival. We call protection over Preside
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer with no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: A major move of God coming to the continent of Africa, and over South America and Australia.
mentions.quote: a major move of God is coming to the continent of Africa
mentions.falsify_match: Revival reported on those continents.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told there are bigger things to take care of because the nation is going down, and that they must stand for America.
mentions.quote: I have bigger things to take care of for our nation is going down
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction about priorities.

mentions.claim_text: Venezuela seen again, with the leader compared to Saddam and a picture shown.
mentions.quote: I keep seeing he will be like a Saddam
mentions.falsify_match: He is removed as Saddam was.

mentions.claim_text: Freedom coming and a new government coming into Venezuela.
mentions.quote: I saw uh freedom coming and a a new government
mentions.falsify_match: A new government installed in Venezuela.

mentions.claim_text: He is overthrown in the days ahead, by his own government or by the United States, with a revolution and a shaking.
mentions.quote: the days ahead becoming overthrown
mentions.falsify_match: He is overthrown.

mentions.claim_text: The youth singing in Tennessee, Oklahoma and Texas, as with the friend he mentions.
mentions.quote: with the youth and the singing singing in Tennessee
mentions.falsify_match: A youth worship movement in those states.

mentions.claim_text: South Korea and Taiwan named, which he says came out of tongues.
mentions.quote: I see South Korea and I see Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: A significant development in both.

mentions.claim_text: More concerning Taiwan and what it is doing in Asia, with North Korea seen too.
mentions.quote: there's more here concerning Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: A Taiwan development that moves the region.

mentions.claim_text: It marks a time and a place in Europe, for what they summon, which he says will be clearly seen.
mentions.quote: It marks a place in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable occult event at a European site.

mentions.claim_text: A drought upon the land which he says is not natural but spiritual.
mentions.quote: This is a drought of spiritual drought
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a spiritual condition with no observable test.

mentions.claim_text: America told to go back to a pioneer work like Little House on the Prairie, having lost its core values, and that time is short.
mentions.quote: Go back to a pioneer work
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction about values.

mentions.claim_text: Give thanks for what you have in this thankful season and over the next two weeks in America.
mentions.quote: Give him praise for what you do have
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: Be thankful for the little things, which he says is why they are told to go back to this.
mentions.quote: you have to be thankful for the little things
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: A cold war that is even colder, an acceleration, with darkness seen all around Europe.
mentions.quote: a cold war that's even colder
mentions.falsify_match: A further hardening of relations across Europe.
